captions.text: Pear's new home screen, / HomeView, is sold on privacy. / But whose [privacy]?
captions.plain: Pear's new home screen, HomeView, is sold on privacy. But whose privacy?

captions.text: In Pear's own ad, / the brother tries to read / his sister's messages. / Only her face [unlocks] them.
captions.plain: In Pear's own ad, the brother tries to read his sister's messages. Only her face unlocks them.

captions.text: Then the ad's happy ending: / the whole family watches her / leave with her boyfriend, / on HomeView's door [camera].
captions.plain: Then the ad's happy ending: the whole family watches her leave with her boyfriend, on HomeView's door camera.

captions.text: Her messages: private. / Her boyfriend: [family viewing].
captions.plain: Her messages: private. Her boyfriend: family viewing.
